crossRefs.note: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun…
Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt…
Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take…

translations.web: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
translations.bsb: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth:
translations.kjv: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
translations.asv: Let thy fountain be blessed; And rejoice in the wife of thy youth.
